lots.key_photo_findings: Dark brown leather with crazed, worn grain. A brass zip with a green-patinated pull sits on an oval ear pocket. lots.question_for_gowans: Is there any ink stamp, maker's label or size inside the helmet (for example an Air Ministry crown, 'Type B', a 22c/ stores reference or a maker's name)? Are the zips working, and is any stitching coming loose around the ear pocket?
